(Currently Amended) Claim 1: An apparatus for profiling a beam of a light emitting semiconductor device, comprising: a light emitting semiconductor device comprising an active region formed on a substrate and configured to generate light when a suitable electrical current is applied to contacts on an upper surface of the device, and a light emitting surface defined by a lower surface of the substrate opposite the contacts; and a transmission medium comprising a first surface in contact with at least part of the light emitting surface of the semiconductor device and a diffusion surface, opposite the first surface, configured to diffuse light emitted from the semiconductor device and transmitted through the transmission medium, wherein the transmission medium is optically transparent.

(Currently Amended) Claim 3: An apparatus according to claim 1, wherein the transmission medium has a refractive index different from a refractive index of the substrate of the light emitting semiconductor device by an amount that is less than ±0.1, such that there is substantially no reflection at the interface between the transmission medium and the substrate of the light emitting semiconductor device.

(Currently Amended) Claim 9: An apparatus according to claim 1, further comprising a pair of probes configured to apply an electrical current to the contacts of the light emitting semiconductor device for causing the active layer to generate light, wherein the probes are coupled to the contacts in a manner that allows for full electrical contact.

(Currently Amended) Claim 23: An apparatus according to claim 1, comprising a plurality of light emitting semiconductor devices, wherein the first surface of the transmission medium is in contact with the light emitting surfaces of more than one of the plurality of light emitting semiconductor devices, and wherein the devices have varying light emitting wavelengths.

(Currently Amended) Claim 25: A method for profiling a beam of a light emitting semiconductor device, the method comprising: applying an electrical current to contacts on an upper surface of a light emitting semiconductor device, the light emitting semiconductor device comprising an active region formed on a substrate and a light emitting surface defined by a lower surface of the substrate opposite the contacts; transmitting light emitted from the light emitting semiconductor device through a transmission medium comprising a first surface in contact with at least part of the light emitting surface of the light emitting semiconductor device and a diffusion surface, opposite the first surface, and configured to diffuse light emitted from the light emitting semiconductor device and transmitted through the transmission medium; and determining a power profile of the light that would be emitted into air from the light emitting semiconductor device at various angles with respect to a normal. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 26: A method for profiling a beam of a light emitting semiconductor device, the method comprising: processing, by a beam profiler, an image to determine an intensity profile of light that would be emitted into air from the light emitting semiconductor device at one or more angles with respect to a normal, the image comprising light emitted from a light emitting semiconductor device comprising an active region formed on a substrate and configured to generate light when a suitable electrical current is applied to contacts on an upper surface of the device, and a light emitting surface defined by a lower surface of the substrate opposite the contacts, the light being transmitted through a transmission medium comprising a first surface in contact with at least part of the light emitting surface of the light emitting semiconductor device and a diffusion surface, opposite the first surface, and configured to diffuse light emitted from the light emitting semiconductor device and transmitted through the transmission medium, wherein the beam profiler additionally accounts for the characteristics of the transmission medium in the processing.

(Currently Amended) Claim 28: A non-transitory computer readable medium comprising computer readable code configured, when read by a computer, to carry out the method according to claim 26, wherein the code further allows the computer to adjust parameters based on optical characteristics of the transmission medium during the profiling process.

(Currently Amended) Claim 29: A computer program comprising computer readable code configured, when read by a computer, to carry out the method according to claim 26, the program being configured to run on a processor that analyzes the data received from the light emitting semiconductor device.
